annotations.title: Inventory Costing: FIFO, LIFO, Weighted Average

description: Work out cost of goods sold and ending inventory under FIFO, LIFO and weighted average cost from the purchases and sales of one item. Send the events in order (opening inventory is a purchase on the first line; each event is a purchase with units and unit cost, or a sale with units) and say whether your books are periodic or perpetual. Get back, for each of the three methods, cost of goods sold, ending units and ending inventory value (and the layers left for FIFO and LIFO, or the average cost), plus how much more cost LIFO puts into cost of goods sold than FIFO. Cost of goods sold plus ending inventory always equals the cost of goods available, to the cent. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/inventory-fifo-lifo). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

events.description: Purchases and sales of one item, oldest first (up to 200). Opening inventory is a purchase on the first line.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of a purchase (up to 4 decimals). Leave out for a sale: sales are costed by the method.

units.description: Units bought or sold (up to 6 decimals).

label.description: Optional label (item or period, your own text, echoed back; not a person).

system.description: periodic = costs are assigned once at the end of the period, from total units sold; perpetual = every sale is costed when it happens.
